characters.name: Gladias
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Veridia chapters. Thoughtful, calm, gentle, philosophical, with an occasional mischievous streak; a little awkward under pressure. Acolyte of the Order of Steering (accepted as a Keeper in ch. 8). Husband of Seila, father of Zven and Lily. Many of his lines are subvocalised whispers through a neck band.

characters.name: Sylka
characters.age: adult (university president; likely middle-aged or older)
characters.voice_notes: Professor Sylka, president of Veridia National University, heard in a livestreamed debate; measured, principled, rhetorical academic.

characters.name: Mov
characters.age: adult (established Order member; Gladias's peer or slightly senior)
characters.voice_notes: Gladias's close friend and mentor in the Order of Steering (a Keeper, selected as a Herald in ch. 8). Wry, sarcastic, sharp, security-paranoid but warm underneath; talks fast and knowledgeably. Partly heard by call/earpiece.

characters.name: Ephelion
characters.voice_notes: Lord Ephelion, Arctic Empire consul/ambassador to Veridia, heard in a livestreamed debate; polished, fluent, commanding and condescending demagogue. Also the signatory of the propaganda poster in ch. 3 (narrated).

characters.name: Chairman
characters.voice_notes: Chairman of the Parliament committee running Gladias's selection hearing; formal, procedural, authoritative, with a touch of ceremony; casts the tie-breaking vote.

characters.name: Vil
characters.voice_notes: 'Uncle Vil', co-parent in Gladias and Seila's co-family and Febric's father. Practical, kind, blunt and down-to-earth. Two of his lines are written messages.

characters.name: Papli
characters.voice_notes: Senator Papli on the selection committee; hostile, populist, combative, anti-intellectual; rapid-fire interruptions.

characters.name: Ancus
characters.voice_notes: Senator Ancus on the selection committee; sympathetic to Gladias, direct, and forceful when he rounds on Papli.

characters.name: Lily
characters.age: child or young teen (school age; exact age not given)
characters.voice_notes: Quiet, downcast, low self-confidence about school results; daughter of Gladias and Seila. Mumbling in ch. 1, sobbing in ch. 8.

characters.name: Seila
characters.age: adult (age not stated; Gladias's wife, roughly his age)
characters.voice_notes: Warm, upbeat, curious and encouraging; a blogger on economics and culture. Wife of Gladias, mother of Zven and Lily. Travels to Freetown and then Iptak.

characters.name: debate moderator
characters.voice_notes: Moderator of the livestreamed Sylka-Ephelion debate; one firm interjection.

characters.name: Verdow
characters.voice_notes: Senator Verdow on the selection committee; neutral, probing, businesslike questioner.

notes: Three letters are shared in this chapter. S: Professor Sylka has the most runs (8:24 both runs, 8:26, 8:28, 8:29, 8:30, 8:38) so she is the default; Seila has 8:12 (a reply message), 8:157 and 8:159 (a call). M: Mov is the default (8:16 is a written message from him; 8:145-8:153 a call); 8:39 is the debate moderator. V: Vil is the default with 4 runs (8:114 and 8:120 are written messages; 8:133 is spoken, two runs); Senator Verdow has 3 runs (8:56, 8:58, 8:60) - a near tie, so check this default suits you. E in this chapter is Lord Ephelion, NOT Emerald (who is E in ch. 3). C is the committee Chairman throughout, including the unattributed opening lines 8:46-8:48. 8:89 has two A runs, both Ancus; 8:94 has two P runs, both Papli. 8:24 Sylka's first line is read by Gladias as subtitles before the audio connects; the debate (8:24-8:40) is a livestream. 8:11, 8:118 and 8:122 are Gladias whispering messages through his neck band.
